# `oaap destination`

named targets an instance may be bound to (oaap.net.destinations 0.1, RFC-0033).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap destination {list,show,add,remove,set-secret,bind,unbind,bindings,ca} [name] [second] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | the destination (list/show/add/remove/set-secret) or the instance (bind/unbind/bindings) |
| `second` | bind: the destination; unbind: the need name |
| `--tenant TENANT` | tenant label (default: the default tenant) |
| `--kind KIND` | (one of `http`, `tcp`; default `http`) |
| `--target TARGET` | https://host[:port][/base], tcp://host:port, via:<tunnel>/<offer> (oaap.net.connector), or through:<instance>/<name> (a tunnel app, RFC-0060) |
| `--auth AUTH` | (one of `none`, `basic`, `bearer`, `header`, `principal_propagation`; default `none`) |
| `--accept-sha256 ACCEPT_SHA256` | principal_propagation: pin the target's server certificate (the fingerprint the first try shows) |
| `--user-claim USER_CLAIM` | principal_propagation: the claim naming the backend user, in order (default sap_user) (repeatable) |
| `--name-check NAME_CHECK` | principal_propagation: user name rules (default sap) (one of ``, `sap`) |
| `--lifetime LIFETIME` | principal_propagation: certificate minutes, 1-60 (default `10`) |
| `--unchecked-claim UNCHECKED_CLAIM` | principal_propagation: who checked by hand that only administrators edit the claim (recorded) |
| `--sample SAMPLE` | ca: print a one-hour certificate of the tenant's CA for this user name, to make the target's mapping rule from (no key) |
| `--propagate` | bind: grant that the app's calls carry the signed-in person (RFC-0066) |
| `--user USER` | basic: the user name |
| `--header HEADER` | header: the header name |
| `--secret-stdin` | read the secret from standard input (else: hidden prompt) |
| `--as AS_` | bind: the need name the app knows (default: the destination's name) |
| `--rehearsal-exception` | bind: deliberately bind a rehearsal (logged, RFC-0030) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | yes |
| `show` | yes |
| `add` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
| `set-secret` | yes |
| `bind` | yes |
| `unbind` | yes |
| `bindings` | yes |
| `ca` | yes |
